title: A week in the studio
description: Handwritten labels and colored hatching compare studio hours from a shared zero baseline.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-ordered categories with unique nonempty id, label, nonnegative value or null, and optional tone a–i. Identity controls stable texture and default color. Invalid and missing values are unavailable; zero keeps a label without a bar. Empty or entirely unavailable data shows an explicit state. Dense categories scroll within the plot.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Measurement label for the heading and tooltips; defaults to Value.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats direct labels and tooltips; defaults to en-US numbers with at most two decimals. Axis ticks use compact numbers.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills its container.

props.name: height
props.description: Total height in pixels; otherwise uses a responsive plot with a readable minimum height.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite Recharts drawing, using language timing and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible chart title; defaults to Values by category.
